setting: Hogwarts AU special Christmas Eve feast and winter ball; not a claim that annual Yule Ball is canonical

attendance.wentHome: can choose authorized return trip before event
attendance.leadAttendance: All eight leads attend the December 24 feast and ball regardless of later holiday plans; departure home can occur after the event.
attendance.holidayTravel: Students who choose home may stay until the ball or return for it; no absence caused by holiday destination.

invitations.availability: All leads physically present; acceptance may still depend on relationship and existing partner
invitations.existingPartnerRestriction: only the player's own confirmed dance partner; no competing NPC partners

notes: No forced shopping or daily food clicks
Invitation dialogue varies by lead personality and player relationship
Event logic must be wired to game clock and holiday locations
Dream-romance rule: all player invitations to a lead are accepted; lead invitations may be declined by player without penalty; no romantic rivals or other lead dance partners.
Affection thresholds and deltas are provisional balance values; user can tune them during character-by-character story review.
status: design specification only; not yet playable

affection.leadInvitation: only if threshold and story conditions met
affection.reinvite: allowed if player currently meets invitation threshold and before ball
affection.display: optional hidden numeric value with relationship stages in heart profile

rules: All meaningful interactions may change emotional state and affection/jealousy based on lead personality and context
Only leads who witness or plausibly learn of another invitation can become jealous
Jealousy response requires existing interest; never universal omniscience
Jealousy fades with time and reassuring interactions
Jealousy is not negative affection and must not cause coercive behavior
Player invitation still always accepted after affection threshold
Player rejection decreases affection with personality-specific small modifiers
emotionalSystem.personalityModifiers: provisional +/-1 to 3 points; tune per character during story review

ballMovement.priority: confirmed dance partner stays together unless player explicitly agrees to split or transition
ballMovement.unpartnered: each lead has independent plausible activities and movements
ballMovement.paired: joint activities, request consent for breaks and excursions; no abandonment

pairedTracks.hyunjae: attentive slow-burn dance and shared break
pairedTracks.eric: energetic dancing, invites player to rest together
